docs.summary: Reads JPEG in JFIF and Exif framing, baseline through progressive and lossless.
Extensions conventionally used for this format, leading dot included, lowercase. Purely informational; detection is driven by content.

Whether pixel decoding is implemented. When false the decoder still reports header facts through `TryIdentify` and `TryDecode` fails with [`NotImplemented`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.ApertureError~NotImplemented).

Whether the pixels this decoder returns are still in the order the file stored them, so a recorded orientation is work outstanding rather than a fact already dealt with. A format that turns its own rows the right way round, as Radiance and the bitmap both do, says no and reports its orientation as a description of the file.

docs.summary: Decodes pixels. The base implementation reports [`NotImplemented`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.ApertureError~NotImplemented); override it together with [`CanDecodePixels`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.Decoders.JpegDecoder~CanDecodePixels) once the codec exists.
Lifts whatever ancillary blocks the container carries. The default finds none, which is the right answer for a format that has nowhere to put them.
